name: James Comer
stance: Supports limited AI guardrails but opposes heavy-handed AI regulation and new federal AI bureaucracies.

statements.text: AI does need smart regulatory guardrails. AI does not need heavy-handed regulations that crush innovation or allow Washington bureaucrats to pick winners and losers in the industry.
It's because they want to create a bunch of new government agencies and bureaucracies and hire new federal employees. That's not the way to address AI.
